description: A Node.js script for scanning project files to identify violations related to Firecrawl fetch logic outside of allowed contexts. It traverses the source directory, reads relevant files, and detects suspicious usage patterns associated with Firecrawl-specific fetch code.

methods.name: walkFiles
methods.description: Recursively walks the directory tree from the given root, returning a list of file paths with specified extensions, ignoring certain directories.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans project files for lines matching suspicious Firecrawl fetch patterns outside of allowed files, returning a list of violation objects.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates violation collection and outputs the results in JSON or plain text format.
